title: Impossible travel: two payments 1,700 km apart within the same hour
summary: A card was used in Mumbai and then, thirty-five minutes later, in Kolkata. No aircraft covers that distance in that time, so at least one payment was not made by the cardholder.
signals: two payments too far apart in too little time
the second payment was made in a city this customer has never transacted from
the payment was made in the middle of the night
resolution: Second payment blocked automatically. Card reissued.
lesson: Impossible travel is a hard physical contradiction, not a probability. It does not need a model — it needs a rule, and the rule should override any score.
